info.title: Registry API

requests.description: ListApis returns matching APIs.
requests.name: GET /v1/projects/{project}/locations/{location}/apis
requests.note: Replace path parameters (e.g. {{VOICE_ID}}) with actual values

requests.description: CreateApi creates a specified API.
requests.name: POST /v1/projects/{project}/locations/{location}/apis
requests.note: Replace path parameters (e.g. {{VOICE_ID}}) with actual values

requests.description:
DeleteApi removes a specified API and all of the resources that it
 owns.
requests.name: DELETE /v1/projects/{project}/locations/{location}/apis/{api}
requests.note: Replace path parameters (e.g. {{VOICE_ID}}) with actual values

requests.description: GetApi returns a specified API.

requests.note: Replace path parameters (e.g. {{VOICE_ID}}) with actual values

requests.description:
ListApiDeploymentRevisions lists all revisions of a deployment.

requests.note: Replace path parameters (e.g. {{VOICE_ID}}) with actual values

requests.description:
RollbackApiDeployment sets the current revision to a specified prior
 revision. Note that this creates a new revision with a new revision ID.
requests.name: POST /v1/projects/{project}/locations/{location}/apis/{api}/deployments/{deployment}:rollback
requests.note: Replace path parameters (e.g. {{VOICE_ID}}) with actual values
